tokens.title: Two‑step search to spot untested exported functions
tokens.content: First locate the function definition with repo_search, then run repo_search for the same name inside the tests folder. If the second search returns no matches, the function lacks test coverage. This works because the absence of references in test files reliably signals missing tests.
